english.title: Proprietor of vehicle use as private hire vehicle without a current section 48 licence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the proprietor of a private hire vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), knowingly used that vehicle as private hire vehicle in a controlled district, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), without having a current licence under section 48 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 46(1)(a), (2) and 76 of the Local Government, Miscellaneous Provisions, Act 1976.
